info.title: Glossy RC Car Customizer and Racer

messages.text:
"Build a single, self-contained HTML web app (using Tailwind CSS, Three.js r128, and Web Audio API) for a glossy 3D RC Car Customizer, 2D Top-Down Track Builder, and Story Mode Racing Game. Use a black outer background, mobile-friendly responsive layout, thumb-friendly touch controls, and localStorage auto-save.

1. Customize Car Tab (3D Showroom)
- Render a glossy 3D car on a showroom turntable using Three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial (clearcoat, studio PMREMGenerator reflections, 3-point lighting, ACES Filmic tone mapping) with drag-to-rotate, scroll-to-zoom, and an Auto-Spin toggle.
- Paint Colors: 6 swatches (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green, Black, White) with live label.
- Car Models (compact grid): Coupe (free), Truck ($200), Formula ($350), Drift Van ($220), Buggy ($250), Wedge ($280), Muscle ($320), plus 2 balanced Secret Cars unlocked with Blue Keys + Cash (4 Blue Keys + $850, and 10 Blue Keys + $1,500).
- Wheels: Classic (free), Sport ($120), Off-Road ($150).
- 10 Mystery-Locked Attachments (5 Cosmetics + 5 Race Tools): Display as \"🔒 Locked Cosmetic\" or \"🔒 Locked Race Tool\" with their price until unlocked via Cash or RNG race drops:
  - Cosmetics: Rear Spoiler, Racing Stripe, Tinted Windows, Neon Underglow, Roof Scoop.
  - Race Tools: Turbo Charger, Grip Tires, Shock Absorbers, Heavy Bumper, Lucky Magnet.
- Performance Upgrades: Engine, Handling, and Aero (Lv.1 to MAX, $100 per level).
- My Garage: Name, save, reload, and delete up to 8 custom builds, plus Randomize and Reset buttons.

2. Track Builder Tab (2D Top-View Editor + Saved Tracks)
- 8x5 tile grid canvas with parts: Straight, Curve, Jump (launches car high above its ground shadow), Loop (360-degree upside-down vertical loop), Bridge (2-level overpass where upper and lower decks block off-track turns), Start Line, and Erase, plus Rotate 90°, Sample Oval, Bridge Track, and Clear buttons.
- Terrains (12 total): 6 free (Grass, Sand, Snow, City, Lava, Jungle) and 6 unlockable cash locations (Neon $600, Candy $800, Swamp $1,000, Space $1,400, Gold $1,800, Prism $2,500). Each terrain adds unique road surface details, matching dust particles, and gradual buildup/grime on the 3D cars.
- Time of Day: Day, Sunset, and Night lighting.
- Saved Tracks: Name, save, load, and delete up to 8 custom tracks.
- Race Stakes: Select $0, $50, $150, or $300 before starting (1st place doubles the stake).

3. Full-Screen Race Mode
- Opens in a full-screen overlay with a close-up responsive follow camera and 4 camera modes (Close, Wide, Chase rotating with the car, Full Track).
- Sync a transparent Three.js OrthographicCamera layer 1-to-1 over the 2D track so all 4 RC-scale cars render as glossy 3D models with moving headlight cones, reflective asphalt sheen, ground shadows, drift smoke, and wall/collision sparks.
- Self-driving forward motion with Left/Right arrow steering (keyboard + bottom-left/bottom-right touch buttons), smooth non-stopping wall sliding, and car-to-car collision bumping.
- Spawn on-road items/hazards paired with the 5 Race Tools: Boost Pads, Oil Slicks, Speed Bumps, Traffic Cones, and Bonus Cash Coins.
- Include a compact animated corner leaderboard (showing live 1st–4th standings and a post-race climb chart only if the player finished higher than they started), Lap Timer, Best Lap, and a Pause Menu.

4. Story Mode (\"The Unseen Streets\")
- Storyline: You are a 3-inch micro-driver piloting an RC racer across giant human sidewalks, parks, and rooftops to beat 4 District Bosses and become City Champion.
- Full-Screen Open-World Mini-City Hub: Drive your RC car around a top-down city to reach District Gates 1–4 (or launch from chapter cards).
- Progression: Districts 1 @COMMENT_BODY@ 2 have 4 Guard qualifiers (1 lap each) before the 2-lap Boss; Districts 3 @COMMENT_BODY@ 4 have 14 Guard qualifiers before the Boss. Each Boss also requires specific car upgrades/wins and 4 Boss Keys. Include a Bosses Defeated trophy bar and Replay Race buttons.
- RNG Drops: Every race awards Cash ($25–$140, plus 1-in-15 $250 jackpot), a 1-in-6 chance on wins to unlock a random non-secret part, a 1-in-400 chance for a Boss Key, and a Boss-only 1-in-800 chance for a Blue Key.
- Web Audio API SFX (unlock, jump, bump, lap, win) with a Sound On/Muted toggle, plus auto-save and a Reset Save button.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, single-file, mobile-friendly RC car customizer, 2D track builder, story racing game, and full-screen Three.js race experience.

## Requirements
- Use a black outer UI, Tailwind CSS, Three.js r128, and Web Audio API.
- Include localStorage autosave, 3D showroom, 8 saved builds, 8 saved tracks, progression, RNG drops, story mode, and responsive touch controls.
- Add 3D race rendering with cameras, track hazards, collision effects, leaderboard, lap timing, and race pause/results.
- Include all requested car models, paint options, parts, upgrades, terrains, and story progression content.

## Decisions
- Implemented as `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`.
- Uses a DOM 2D track canvas with a separate Three.js race scene and orthographic tracking overlay.
- Used procedural Three.js car geometry, track geometry, and canvas textures to keep the app self-contained.
- Reduced showroom and race lighting exposure to improve glossy car readability.
- Added low-profile greenhouse/cabin geometry and fixed incomplete model branch configuration.

## Work State
### Completed
- Tailwind-based app shell, tab navigation, responsive controls, modal/toast UI, localStorage save/reset.
- Currency HUD, paint swatches, car models, wheels, parts, upgrades, garage save/load/delete, randomize/reset.
- 8×5 track builder, tool palette, terrain/time selection, track save/load/delete, stake controls, oval/bridge/clear presets.
- Three.js showroom with physical clearcoat materials, turntable, zoom/rotation, lighting, and autosave UI.
- Procedural track world, checkpoints, track props, road surfaces, items, 3D cars, particles, collisions, and race cameras.
- Race HUD, countdown, leaderboard, lap timer, best lap, pause menu, restart/quit/results, keyboard and touch steering.
- Web Audio SFX hooks and sound toggle.
- Story state structures, district boss data, guard qualifier rules, boss keys, Blue Key/Blue-key unlock logic, and RNG award system.
- Added smoke, spark, curb, wall, headlight cone, and contact-shadow utilities.
- Tuned car models and showroom/race lighting with a darker ACES exposure.

### Active
- Final visual and race validation remains active.
- Car rendering was adjusted toward more visible cabins and reduced overexposure, but screenshots should be rerun to verify the latest file state.
- Hub/Story implementation may require a final browser pass because it contains large appended sections.

### Blocked
- No explicit technical blocker remains documented.

## Next Move
1. Run a syntax/browser validation of `index.html`; check console errors and initialization failures.
2. Capture and inspect current showroom, track-builder, race, chase, full-track, and story screenshots.
3. Verify all large `switch`/branch car-model cases, especially name and append function replacements, are syntactically and visually valid.
4. Test race startup, steering, item pickups, lap completion, finish-place calculation, results, and replay.
5. Test story district launch/replay flows and boss key upgrade requirements.
6. Test localStorage persistence and reset behavior in a fresh browser profile.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete application and primary continuation target.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/05-chase.jpg`: Latest rendered chase screenshot from validation.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/07-race3.jpg`: Latest race screenshot from validation.

## Important Context
- The app is intended to remain in one HTML file, including embedded CSS/JavaScript and CDN-loaded Tailwind/Three.js.
- Three.js r128 is loaded from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`.
- A prior `buildCar` signature mismatch was corrected: it now accepts `opts.race || cfg.race`.
- `Race.finishRace()` now derives place from `finishOrder`.
- `Race.tick()` and `Race.updateItems(dt)` are core runtime methods for race completion and hazard/item behavior.
- Added helper textures/functions: `getSmokeTex()`, `getSparkTex()`, and `buildFeatureProps(world)`.
- Race scene, showroom, and environment lighting use ACES Filmic tone mapping.
- Changes are currently uncommitted unless the next agent has additional repository state not carried in this summary.

"Build a single, self-contained HTML web app (using Tailwind CSS, Three.js r128, and Web Audio API) for a glossy 3D RC Car Customizer, 2D Top-Down Track Builder, and Story Mode Racing Game. Use a black outer background, mobile-friendly responsive layout, thumb-friendly touch controls, and localStorage auto-save.

1. Customize Car Tab (3D Showroom)
- Render a glossy 3D car on a showroom turntable using Three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial (clearcoat, studio PMREMGenerator reflections, 3-point lighting, ACES Filmic tone mapping) with drag-to-rotate, scroll-to-zoom, and an Auto-Spin toggle.
- Paint Colors: 6 swatches (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green, Black, White) with live label.
- Car Models (compact grid): Coupe (free), Truck ($200), Formula ($350), Drift Van ($220), Buggy ($250), Wedge ($280), Muscle ($320), plus 2 balanced Secret Cars unlocked with Blue Keys + Cash (4 Blue Keys + $850, and 10 Blue Keys + $1,500).
- Wheels: Classic (free), Sport ($120), Off-Road ($150).
- 10 Mystery-Locked Attachments (5 Cosmetics + 5 Race Tools): Display as \"🔒 Locked Cosmetic\" or \"🔒 Locked Race Tool\" with their price until unlocked via Cash or RNG race drops:
  - Cosmetics: Rear Spoiler, Racing Stripe, Tinted Windows, Neon Underglow, Roof Scoop.
  - Race Tools: Turbo Charger, Grip Tires, Shock Absorbers, Heavy Bumper, Lucky Magnet.
- Performance Upgrades: Engine, Handling, and Aero (Lv.1 to MAX, $100 per level).
- My Garage: Name, save, reload, and delete up to 8 custom builds, plus Randomize and Reset buttons.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete the existing single-file RC car customizer, track builder, and story racing game in `index.html`, then validate and polish it.

## Requirements
- Use Tailwind CSS, Three.js r128, Web Audio API, black outer UI, responsive mobile-friendly controls, and localStorage autosave.
- Include the requested showroom cars, paints, parts, upgrades, garage saves; 2D track editor, terrains, track saves, and stakes; full-screen 3D racing, hazards, cameras, HUD, and results; and story hub, district progression, qualifiers, bosses, keys, RNG drops, audio, and reset.
- Save validation screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide); read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- Keep the implementation self-contained in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`.
- Use a DOM 2D track canvas with a separate Three.js race scene and orthographic tracking overlay.
- Use procedural car and track geometry and canvas textures to keep the app self-contained.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the app shell, customization, garage, track builder, race mode, story progression/hub, save/reset, audio hooks, and responsive layouts.
- Fixed race grid placement during countdown, timer startup, finish-place calculation, and player starting position; refined car cabins, wheel visibility, headlight beams, race background, and mobile camera/HUD layout.
- Checked inline JavaScript syntax and exercised showroom, track, race, pause, camera modes, story/hub, and mobile views in browser; validation screenshots are in `screenshots/`.

### Active
- Final validation and requirement coverage remain incomplete; review the latest changes and test any unverified progression, persistence, hazards, and mobile flows.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check `git status` and run a fresh inline JavaScript syntax check on `index.html`.
2. Run browser checks against the current file, especially story qualifier/boss requirements and rewards, save/reset persistence, race hazards and lap/results flow, and mobile touch steering.
3. Capture and inspect only the latest screenshots for any remaining visual issues; make focused fixes in `index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete application and primary continuation target.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/46-mobile-shop3.jpg`: latest screenshot attempt; inspect only if it exists and is current.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in the recorded work state.
- Three.js r128 is loaded from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`.
- Car rendering uses `buildCar({ ... })`; race lifecycle centers on `Race.start()`, `Race.tick()`, `Race.updateItems(dt)`, and `Race.finishRace()`.
- Story progression and hub code are appended later in `index.html`; prior browser checks noted that gate, guard, and boss flows need thorough validation.
- The user’s story qualifier text includes `Districts 1 @COMMENT_BODY@ 2` and `Districts 3 @COMMENT_BODY@ 4`; interpret these as district ranges 1–2 and 3–4.
